100% Free, Always

Ramzunā Languages
Language Access Should Cross Every Border

Ramzunā Languages is a non-profit that is dedicated to providing free and personalised English,French and German lessons to Palestinian students.

How We Teach

🎓

Language Lessons & Conversations

Empowering Palestinian students through general, conversation, academic and business language lessons.

How It Works

From Sign-Up to Fluency in 4 Steps

We have made it simple to start learning — or to start teaching.

01

Sign Up Free

Tell us your language goals, current level, and availability.

02

Get Assessed

We assess your level to match you with the right course.

03

Be Matched

We pair you with a vetted volunteer educator based on your language, level, and schedule.

04

Start Learning

Meet online for regular lessons — in a small group by default, one-to-one sessions, or asynchronously on your own schedule.
